title: Library Orientation
label: Annual Program
description: Library instruction/orientation for new students is given at the start of each school year. Library tours and lectures about library organization and its services are examples of the instructional/orientation programs of the library.
when: Conducted at the start of each school year. Specific schedules are provided by the library and academic departments.
who: New students, including incoming freshmen and transferees, are the primary participants in these orientation programs.
what: Topics include library tours, lectures on library organization, and an introduction to the various services available to support your studies.
contact: Departments may coordinate with the library to schedule group orientations. Contact the librarian at library@pup.edu.ph or visit the library for scheduling.
